pr_title: Fix player controls not hiding if resumed from media button
pr_comment:
@ktprograms I'm currently trying to understand if this is the correct place for ``hideControls``.
But the code who is calling this is a bit complicated: ![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/40789489/140546592-2bce285d-2970-4af5-97a5-8e2c38bc85f6.png) (It also pretty annoying that there are zero comments and the code got rewritten in like 10 commits)
Because when e.g. ``Player#onPaused`` is called then there is always a call for ``showControls(400)`` executed. However this is not the case in ``Player#onPlaying`` but I don't know why.
@litetex what do you think about my suggestions? If they look good, commit them and then merge and squash (after 0.22.1)

I think you can try to add them 😄

Hey guys, is this meant to be fixed now in release 23?

Because it's definitely not. Resuming from the BT headset play/pause button still keeps the UI on screen forever.
It was meant to be fixed, yes, but the latest ExoPlayer update broke the original fix, and a new fix has been provided in the PR linked above: #8315.

review_comment:
Not sure why this check existed here in the first place, what can/should happen when pressing Space outside of full screen? (typing in the search or comment box?)
If in doubt, could just leave the original if() check, and just add the if (isPlaying) part.
See #5331. In that PR there doesn't seem to be any explanation about why the `if (isFullscreen)`. So I think we can safely remove it, what do you think @mbarashkov?
@Stypox In that PR, I had to do this because not in full screen space key was used on TV's to navigate the screen vertically, as I recall.
Ok, that makes sense, thank you. Then I'll restore the previous `if (isFullscreen)`.
So that the behaviour is consistent with manually pausing (keeps the controls visible).
Okay but why is this only the case for the full-screen player?

The `if (isFullscreen)` was already there so I just left it. But I've tested and it works fine even when not in fullscreen so I've removed the `if (isFullscreen)` in https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/pull/7341/commits/29348411520f56f07865c6deef722ae107b9a205
